events.title: Vacation Bible School
events.description: Join us for a week of faith, fun, and friendship! VBS is open to all children and is one of the highlights of our summer. Crafts, songs, games, and God's Word — all wrapped into one amazing week.

events.title: Back to School Picnic
events.description: Join us for our back-to-school picnic to kick off the start of the 2026-2027 school year!
